title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum Glauber-Sudarshan P Representation Algorithm (PEQGSA)** embeds **prime-number encoding** into the **Glauber-Sudarshan P representation**, a formalism widely used in **quantum optics** to describe the quantum state of the electromagnetic field. The P representation expresses the density matrix of a quantum state as a weighted sum (or integral) over coherent states, allowing quantum states to be treated as classical-like distributions. By introducing **prime-number modulation** into the P representation, we enable **dynamic control** over the weights, coherent state superpositions, and quantum-classical transitions, providing more flexible manipulation of quantum optical fields.
